# What is MLD Memorial Sansthan?
MLD Memorial Sansthan is an educational society (sansthan) based in Kekri, Ajmer district, Rajasthan, India. It runs a family of 7+ educational institutions — schools, colleges, and diploma institutes — providing quality education from Nursery to Senior Secondary, undergraduate (B.A., B.Sc., B.Com, BBA, BCA), professional (D.Pharma, B.Ed, D.El.Ed, Shiksha Shastri), and vocational (Livestock Assistant Diploma) programmes.

# Institutions
- MLD International Academy (school: Nursery to Senior Secondary, English medium)
- Balika Uchch Madhyamik Academy (girls' school)
- Uchch Madhyamik Academy (school)
- Memorial Sansthan Colleges (BA, BSc, BCom, BBA, BCA)
- MLD Pharmacy College (D.Pharma — Diploma in Pharmacy, PCI approved)
- Mahila Shikshan Prashikshan Mahavidyalay (B.Ed, D.El.Ed, Shiksha Shastri — women teacher training, NCTE approved)
- Live Stock Assistant Diploma Institute (2-year Livestock Assistant Diploma)

# Top Programmes
## D.Pharma (Diploma in Pharmacy)
- Duration: 2 years
- Level: Diploma
- Mode: Full-time, On-campus
- Medium: English
- Approving Body: Pharmacy Council of India (PCI)
- Career: Registered Pharmacist, Hospital Pharmacist, Medical Representative, Retail Pharmacy, Community Pharmacy
- Eligibility: 12th (Science — Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Mathematics)
- Location: Kekri, Ajmer, Rajasthan

## B.Ed (Bachelor of Education)
- Duration: 2 years
- Level: Postgraduate (after graduation)
- Mode: Full-time, On-campus
- Medium: English/Hindi
- Approving Body: National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE)
- Career: School Teacher (PRT/TGT/PGT), Government Teacher (REET/CTET), Education Counsellor, Academic Coordinator
- Eligibility: Graduation (any stream) with minimum 50% marks
- Location: Kekri, Ajmer, Rajasthan

## Live Stock Assistant Diploma
- Duration: 2 years
- Level: Diploma
- Career: Livestock Inspector, Veterinary Assistant, Dairy Farm Manager, Government Veterinary Department
- Eligibility: 12th (Science/Agriculture)
- Location: Kekri, Ajmer, Rajasthan

# Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Where is MLD Memorial Sansthan located?
A: MLD Memorial Sansthan is located in Kekri, Ajmer district, Rajasthan, India (PIN 305404).

Q: Is MLD a university?
A: No. MLD Memorial Sansthan is an educational society (sansthan) running multiple affiliated institutions. It is not a university. The colleges are affiliated to recognised universities and the pharmacy college is approved by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI).

Q: What courses does MLD offer?
A: MLD offers D.Pharma (Diploma in Pharmacy), B.Ed (Bachelor of Education), D.El.Ed, Shiksha Shastri, BA, BSc, BCom, BBA, BCA, Live Stock Assistant Diploma, and schooling from Nursery to Senior Secondary.

Q: Is D.Pharma at MLD approved?
A: Yes. The D.Pharma programme at MLD Pharmacy College is approved by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI). Graduates are eligible to register with the State Pharmacy Council.

Q: Is B.Ed at MLD approved?
A: Yes. The B.Ed programme is approved by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE).

Q: How to get admission at MLD?
A: Admission process: (1) Check eligibility, (2) Apply online or in person, (3) Document verification, (4) Counselling / merit list, (5) Fee payment and enrolment.

Q: What is the fee structure?
A: Fee varies by programme. MLD is known for affordable education. Contact the admissions office for the current fee structure and scholarship options.

Q: Does MLD provide hostel facility?
A: Yes, separate hostels for boys and girls with CCTV, warden, and mess facilities.

Q: Does MLD provide placement?
A: Yes, MLD provides placement assistance, career counselling, and government exam coaching (REET, CTET, Patwari, etc.).
